page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan, of which only the left part is shown here. Left page: running text in two columns, the left column (narrow, from "pinus & Carolus" down to "Caput XVII.") and the right column of the upper half beside it, with marginal notes in the left margin ("Irene Imperatrix..." and similar) and a note in the right margin ("Dissidia Scholasticorum de genere cultus"). Running head at top; page number 249 at top right. Below the left column: heading "CAPUT XVII." and "VII. Quo genere Cultus Imagines honorandae sint." followed by the first line of a paragraph.; One column of running text, right of the scan, with small marginal notes in the right margin beside the lower part; a fragment of a line at the foot left. Text ends at the bottom with a line of running text.

page.notes: Right column of the upper half, continuing: "nere cultûs Imaginum, est inutilis & supervacanea. A quocunque enim removetur genus, ab eodem removetur & species. At nos precedente rapite cultum omnem, praesertim religiosum, ab Imaginibus removimus: Ergo superuacaneum est disputare, quo cultûs genere Imagines sint honorande & colende. Examinabimus tamen Iesuitae rationes, sed, propter dictam causam, brevissimè. Primò, de hac quaestione tres Scholasticorum addueit sententias, & quidem, ut ipsi videtur aliquo modo diversas seu contrarias. Unde colligitur, totum hoc ipsorum dogma de cultu & vene-" (cut off at the lower edge). Marginal notes: left margin "Irene Imperatrix quae fuerit & quales."; right margin "Dissidia Scholasticorum de genere cultûs". Lower part of the page is cut off. Lower left corner shows a faint fragment of a line from the page below, unreadable; the right-margin notes are small and partly blurred, transcribed as far as legible. Page number and running head not visible.
